nodes.label: Karvey Method (spec-driven development for Claude Code)
nodes.rationale: Takes a change from idea to production through a 13-phase pipeline with approval gates plus a support layer; stack-agnostic and spiral.

nodes.label: Afán — Ona (Selknam) word meaning zeal
nodes.rationale: Name expresses not stopping until the result is truly achieved.

nodes.label: Multilingual page design (EN default, ES/PT/DE/ZH switch)
nodes.rationale: Five lang-block divs; English by default; switcher links set ?lang=; choice remembered in localStorage 'karvey-lang'; early head script picks language (?lang= -> saved -> en) to avoid a flash of English and falls back to en if block missing; heading ids namespaced per language (en-*, es-*...); skills themselves stay in English.

nodes.label: Kiro (cc-sdd) and gstack (Garry Tan) inspiration
nodes.rationale: Conceptual inspiration only; no code from those projects.

nodes.label: Spec-driven principle
nodes.rationale: Every change starts from a PRD; EARS requirements trace back to it; living specs accumulate per capability.

nodes.label: Stack-agnostic principle
nodes.rationale: Project declares targets and each phase adapts (CLI mockup = transcript, API = request/response).

nodes.label: Approval gates principle
nodes.rationale: Each phase produces a document in docs/spec/ and asks for OK; --autoplan batches gates but does not skip them.

nodes.label: Spiral, not line principle
nodes.rationale: Pipeline is the happy path; findings return along bug/spec-gap/emergent edges; ready only when converged.

nodes.label: Nothing left hanging principle
nodes.rationale: Mandatory closing ritual, discovery backlog, BUG-NN tracker, cleanup of absorbed branches.

nodes.label: Human OK for production principle
nodes.rationale: Prod merge requires explicit approval recorded in approvals.prod; never delegated to an agent; never manual deploy.

nodes.label: Measured, not remembered principle
nodes.rationale: Only what was verified in session is reported with command and evidence; session hook checks saved state vs live repos.

nodes.label: Plugin org chart (32 skills, 22 rules, hooks)
nodes.rationale: 32 skills = 1 orchestrator + 13 phases + 18 support.

nodes.label: Support layer (18 skills)
nodes.rationale: Not phases: they do not advance spec.json:phase (except karvey-iterate's controlled backward revision transition); honour same gates and hooks.

nodes.label: --autoplan mode
nodes.rationale: Chains planning phases 0->5, escalating only substantive decisions (taste, scope, security).

nodes.label: Living specs specs/{capability}/spec.md
nodes.rationale: Cumulative per capability; updated by merging spec-deltas at archive.

nodes.label: findings.md (single findings inbox)
nodes.rationale: test, qa and browse only observe and classify into it; karvey-iterate is the only router.

nodes.label: approvals.prod {by, date, ref}
nodes.rationale: Human prod OK recorded in git; ref can cite D-NN.

nodes.label: Agent handoff (docs/spec/agent: handoff.md, state.json, board.md)
nodes.rationale: Works same with one agent; with a team only location changes to {ops_repo}/agents/<rol>/.

nodes.label: ops change type
nodes.rationale: init -> requirements(lite) -> infra(command plan) -> tasks -> execution+verification -> archive; skips mockup/design/architecture unless trust boundaries change.

nodes.label: hotfix change type
nodes.rationale: iterate (BUG-NN) -> impl -> test (regression) -> deploy; fix + BUG-NN + regression test in the same PR.

nodes.label: Parent change (links.children)
nodes.rationale: No code of its own; deployed only when every child deployed or discarded by decision.

nodes.label: Documentation-only PR
nodes.rationale: Lightweight CI (spec lint); never triggers a deployment.

nodes.label: Iteration loop (three feedback edges)
nodes.rationale: Pipeline 0->12 is the happy path; these three edges are reality.

nodes.label: Finding type: bug
nodes.rationale: Litmus: spec is right, code is wrong. Blocks until resolved.

nodes.label: Finding type: spec-gap
nodes.rationale: Litmus: had we specified properly, implementation would differ. Blocks until resolved.

nodes.label: Finding type: emergent
nodes.rationale: Litmus: good idea, but another change. Does not block; only must be captured.

nodes.label: BUG-NN tracker (docs/bugs_dev_testing.md)
nodes.rationale: States DETECTADO -> DIAGNOSTICADO -> EN FIX -> RESUELTO -> REABIERTO; numbering never resets.

nodes.label: Spec revision sub-cycle
nodes.rationale: approvals.requirements set false, +1 iteration_count, revision_history entry; only affected requirement amended; ripple only to affected phases.

nodes.label: Discovery backlog (docs/spec/backlog.md)
nodes.rationale: Markdown source of truth mirrored in tracker; swept at archive into new change-ids.

nodes.label: Convergence rule
nodes.rationale: A change is ready only when findings.md has no open bug or spec-gap and every emergent item is in the backlog.

nodes.label: Shared rules catalogue (22 rules)
nodes.rationale: Skills cite rules instead of repeating them; local copies must be byte-for-byte identical to the canonical.

nodes.label: Hooks: active on install vs opt-in
nodes.rationale: A skill is guidance and guarantees nothing; a hook actually blocks. Opt-in hooks written to project settings.json, never imposed globally.

nodes.label: SessionStart hook karvey-session-context.sh
nodes.rationale: Re-injects identity/manifest/board/handoff; measures branch/commit drift vs state.json; inert outside Karvey projects; notices missing team settings.

nodes.label: Statusline karvey-statusline.sh
nodes.rationale: Shows context, account limits, cost and TIME TO ROTATE; thresholds 100k/150k/8h; 150k from measurement (588k context turn costs 7x an 80k one).

nodes.label: git-flow-guard hook
nodes.rationale: Blocks direct push to prod, commit on dev/master and manual deploys.

nodes.label: plan-gate hook
nodes.rationale: Blocks Edit/Write/destructive commands without an approved-plan marker.

nodes.label: standards-guard (described in rule)
nodes.rationale: Warns/blocks MUST NOT patterns without approved deviation in deviations.md.

nodes.label: clickup-sync-guard (described in rule)
nodes.rationale: Tool-agnostic; warns when phase advances without closing comment/status.

nodes.label: Team settings (notifications + management)
nodes.rationale: Replaces assumed Google Chat + ClickUp status; HainTech's flow keeps working because it declares it, not because it is default.

nodes.label: Settings asked on first use, not on install
nodes.rationale: A Claude Code plugin has no install hook; earliest moment is first use: session hook warns and karvey-init asks (step 3.2).

nodes.label: notifications.channel (google-chat/slack/teams/email/webhook/none)
nodes.rationale: Targets never read from CLAUDE.md tables; failed send reported, not swallowed; webhook stores secret name not URL.

nodes.label: management.tool (clickup/jira/linear/azure-boards/github-projects/spreadsheet/markdown/other)
nodes.rationale: PLAN.md always valid fallback.

nodes.label: Five logical states (todo/in_progress/review/done/blocked)
nodes.rationale: Skills write logical status, never a literal name; mapping read from real tool and confirmed once, never guessed.

nodes.label: Pipeline-triggered deploy (feature -> dev -> PR -> master)
nodes.rationale: Never by hand by person or agent; push to dev deploys dev, merge to master deploys prod; names from project.json:branch_flow.

nodes.label: PR gates and human OK
nodes.rationale: Approval never requested on a red gate (turns approval into rubber stamp); skipping policy is human's responsibility.

nodes.label: Post-deploy canary
nodes.rationale: Spaced iterations against real runtime in dev and prod; reinforces zero downtime.

nodes.label: Branch hygiene
nodes.rationale: Absorption verified (merged, cherry, merge-tree); absorbed deleted with -d never -D; unabsorbed reported, never silently cleaned.

nodes.label: Visible version by environment
nodes.rationale: Version read from version file at build time, never a pipeline variable (goes stale silently); DEV shows -dev.N+sha, PROD release version; canary checks it.

nodes.label: Agent-team layer (optional)
nodes.rationale: Pipeline carries axis of the work; this layer adds axis of the worker. Opt-in, not default; absent without docs/spec/team.json.

nodes.label: Measured team cost warning
nodes.rationale: 6 agents, 3 days, ~US$1,000, ended back at single agent; 588k-context turn cost 7x an 80k one; each hop is fresh context, no shared cache.

nodes.label: Install and update via plugin marketplace karvey-methods
